exposure: Fetal ECG (ST-Analyser or STAN) for intrapartum fetal heart rate monitoring
cohort: This abstract discusses findings from various studies, including a meta-analysis involving 26,446 women undergoing intrapartum monitoring.
finding: A recent meta-analysis of six randomised controlled trials found a 36% reduction in the rate of neonatal metabolic acidosis with the use of Fetal ECG (STAN).
mod_finding: Initial randomised controlled trials showed promise in STAN reducing operative delivery rates (instrumental vaginal births and emergency caesarean sections), though a meta-analysis concluded that Fetal Blood Sampling (FBS) did not reduce caesarean section rates.
